project_info.theme: Galaxy S25 Series introduction hero poster
project_info.color_palette: Silver titanium, navy blue, black, white, electric blue accent glow

main_subject.detail: Premium close-cropped launch poster showing four overlapping Galaxy S25 series devices arranged radially to emphasize camera arrays, device finishes, and an S Pen, with a minimal title at the bottom.
main_subject.style: Photorealistic flagship product hero render, luxury hardware photography, minimal Samsung launch aesthetic

composition_elements.text: Introducing Galaxy S25 Series / Galaxy AI
items: Top Left: Silver device back with three large camera rings.
Top Right: Front display corner showing the lockscreen and a 'Now Brief Get today's highlight' pill over a deep blue-lit center seam.
Bottom Left: Another silver/titanium device back with larger camera cluster plus a white S Pen partially entering from the corner.
Bottom Right: Navy blue device back with triple camera layout and flash.

Center/Background: Radial meeting point of four devices with cool blue glow; lower center white title 'Introducing Galaxy S25 Series' and 'Galaxy AI' with sparkle icon; tiny legal footnote at the bottom left.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Sharp metallic reflections, camera lens gloss, cool electric blue seam glow, premium high-contrast hardware mood

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for Galaxy S25 Series introduction hero poster. Centerpiece is a radial arrangement of four overlapping Galaxy S25 devices showing multiple back finishes, camera arrays, a front display corner with a 'Now Brief Get today's highlight' pill, and a white S Pen. Background is a dark premium studio setup with cool blue glow at the center seam. Surrounding elements: exact lower title 'Introducing Galaxy S25 Series', 'Galaxy AI' with sparkle icon, and a tiny legal footnote in the lower-left corner. Technical style: photorealistic product render, studio lighting, sharp metallic reflections and cool electric blue seam glow, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped

assets.name: Galaxy S25 series multi-device hardware render
assets.usage: Match exact camera-ring geometry, finishes, device overlap, and S Pen placement.

assets.name: Now Brief lockscreen pill

assets.usage: Preserve the small callout pill and its placement on the front device.

assets.name: bottom introductory typography

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Use refs for the exact multi-device arrangement. This poster depends on tight hardware composition and lighting; do not simplify it into a single phone hero shot.
